title: Does Mysterious Countdown Tease Fallout New Vegas Remaster? Probably Not. - NewsBreak
text:
By Zak Wojnar ,
12 hours ago
A mysterious countdown has appeared on the " Fallout Explorer " website meant to promote Season 2 of the popular Prime Video series. Naturally, fans are in something of a tizzy, speculating that it could herald the long-awaited arrival of a Fallout 3 or New Vegas remaster. Is that possible?
I mean, anything's possible. I could drop a rock and it could fall to the floor, or it could rise to the ceiling. Anything's possible, right? In all likelihood, it will lead to a behind-the-scenes documentary about the entire season. Why put a video game reveal in a promotional website for a TV series, right?
Bethesda
Then again, Fallout's first season ended with the tease that Season 2 would be set in the Mojave Wasteland, which is really what kicked off all the "New Vegas Remastered" rumors that have pervaded the Bethesda discourse for the last year or so. Perhaps Season 2 will similarly end with a change of scenery. Maybe the action will shift to Washington D.C., AKA the Capital Wasteland. And maybe this time, Bethesda will actually be smart enough to have a little game/TV synergy by releasing a remaster of Fallout 3. Heck, what if the remaster announcement is made during the closing credits of the episode itself? That might be crossing a line into corporate sleaziness, but we're just spitballing. There are no bad ideas in a brainstorming session, right? Monkey tennis?
After the surprise Shadow Drop release of Oblivion Remastered, Bethesda's previous game before Fallout 3, fans are now perpetually on edge, not knowing when Bethesda might suddenly spring a new remaster on us. Fallout 3 and/or New Vegas Remastered could happen any time. It could happen today, it could happen tomorrow. Maybe it will never happen! Or maybe Bethesda will wait until the absolute right moment for maximum cultural impact. And what better moment than the season finale of the Fallout TV series?
